purpose: Collect the v0.0.1 release-prep receipts and provenance in one artifact so the next migration slice can proceed from durable evidence rather than chat memory.

proven: Vaporize focused tests pass through Vaporize toolchain mode.
Legacy XcodeGen project.yml files parse through the Swift YAML read bridge.
All 155 discovered project.yml files under private/universal/substrate/collectives parsed through inspect-project-yml.
Concourse old XcodeGen script build and Vaporize app build both pass after Vaporize derives legacy WRAPPER_NAME from project.yml.
Concourse project.pkl evaluates through PklSwift and matches the Swift-read project.yml parity signature with zero mismatches.
Concourse project.pkl generates transitional AppleProjectSpec YAML through PklSwift, and the generated YAML compares back to Pkl with zero mismatches.
JSON release evidence validates through Vaporize validate-json.
notProven: The full fleet builds through Vaporize.
Remaining XcodeGen surfaces are migrated or quarantined.
Vaporize v0.0.1 is ready for final internal-essential release.

sourceChangeSurfaces.purpose: Adds AppleProjectSpecCore plus PklSwift and Yams dependency wiring.
Pins PklSwift, Yams, and transitive dependencies resolved by SwiftPM.
Defines Swift project model, PklSwift loader, transitional YAML generator, inspection/comparison/generation receipts, and legacy app bundle name resolver.
Adds inspect-project-yml, compare-project-yml-pkl, and generate-project-yml modes, and uses project.yml-derived app bundle name compatibility for Xcode app builds.
Covers Concourse project.yml parsing, PklSwift parity comparison, transitional YAML generation, multi-target parsing, and WRAPPER_NAME expansion.
Regenerated by the old XcodeGen reference path during the old/new build comparison.
Defines the first Pkl AppleProjectSpec schema for parity-before-generation migration work.
Ports Concourse legacy project.yml into the first Pkl parity specimen and keeps build-setting values string-shaped where required.
Generated transitional AppleProjectSpec YAML from Concourse project.pkl; migration evidence only, not checked-in project.yml replacement or .xcodeproj world-state.

boundaries: This artifact is provenance for release-prep work, not founder approval.
This artifact does not mark Vaporize v0.0.1 internally releasable.
Legacy project.yml read compatibility is a bridge for comparison and migration, not the forward source-of-truth claim.
Generated transitional AppleProjectSpec YAML is migration evidence, not a checked-in project.yml replacement or .xcodeproj generator.
Concourse build comparison is one-specimen evidence and must not be generalized to the whole fleet without additional receipts.
